## Corpus tutor chat KV-corruption + missing-nav fix (2026-06-08 session 5)

User report: chat 'still sucks' - replied with identical canned greeting to every input (hi / whats cad / lets review the card all got 'Hi! I'm here to help... 1 card due, weakest cardiology'); and 'we dont see navigation'.

TWO ROOT CAUSES, both fixed + browser-witnessed with the real Bonsai-1.7B model loaded:

1. CHAT (tutor.js runChat): re-fed the FULL messages array (system+growing history) on every generate WHILE reusing a persisted state.pastKV DynamicCache. transformers.js then double-counts context (cached prefix + re-encoded full prompt) -> model ignores the new user turn -> emits a generic templated reply. FIX: build a FRESH per-call 'let pastKV = new DynamicCache()' inside runChat, dispose after generate settles; removed state.pastKV + state.kvSysKey entirely (KV is an intra-generation accelerator, NOT a cross-turn store, because we always re-feed the whole conversation). PROOF (browser, model ready): 'hi'->greeting, 'whats cad'->CAD/cardiology explanation, 'lets review the card'-> emitted \`\`\`tool start_session{cardiology}\`\`\` tool call. Three distinct context-relevant replies. Regenerate clean (no dup user turn).

2. NAV (app.js): the SDK app shell setupSdkApp() THROWS mid-mount - TypeError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading xmlns)' in 247420.js hyperscript et() when AppShell renders corpus's raw el()-built mainContent DOM subtree. The catch only console.warn'd 'using fallback' but there was NO fallback (mountTopbar was defined but never called anywhere), so the page kept the static empty header -> ZERO navigation on desktop AND mobile (top .nav display:none on mobile, .bottom-nav never populated). FIX: (a) catch now resets sdkRender=null + calls mountTopbar() so the legacy render() stage path + raw nav render; (b) added mountBottomNav() called unconditionally in init (the .bottom-nav <nav> in index.html was never populated); (c) base CSS '.bottom-nav{display:none}' so it's mobile-only; mobile tutor panel moved bottom:0->56px above the bottom-nav; .bottom-nav z 100->101 so it stays clickable with coach open. browser-110: desktop 6 navlinks clickable; browser-105: mobile 5 bottom-nav links, navReachable with coach open.

Kept the SDK-shell-crash (xmlns) as a known fragility - the legacy fallback is the robust shipped path; deep minified-SDK fix deferred as low-value.

Also: app.js search btn label was a decorative command-key glyph -> ASCII 'ctrl+k'. test.js: added fresh-per-call-KV + bottom-nav + sdk-fallback assertions (19 pass). Browser is PLAYWRIGHT (page.setViewportSize not setViewport). browser verb exec cap is 14s - multi-turn model chat must be split across dispatches (send in one, poll reply in next).
